name: Cursed Canvas
source:
Two thieves, Eleanor and Sylvia, have broken in to steal a painting, but Syl thinks the whole ordeal seems poorly thoughtout.

Surely now is the best time to argue about it.

[From [url=https://nightspores.itch.io/cursed-canvas]Itch.io[/url]]
